description: Full physics, Tri-Track 5-year TCO (target/conservative/current_2026), and credit-underwriting audit for an orbital AI cluster. Supports Vera Rubin NVL72, SpaceX Starmind AI1, Google Trillium TPU v6e (real 918 TF BF16 / 1,836 TOPS INT8), Blackwell GB200, Terafab 370K, Van Allen radiation belts, Turyshev Gamma (bits/J), van Berkel bisection roofline, and 4-pillar OCEI v2.4 scoring.

altitude_km.description: Orbital altitude in km (320=VLEO, 575=FCC DA 26-1273 SSO, 650=Dawn-Dusk SSO, 1500=High-LEO).

beta_deg.description: Solar beta angle in degrees (75-90 yields zero eclipse at 650 km).

power_mw.description: Target cluster electrical capacity in megawatts (1 to 100,000 MW).

realism_mode.description: target (canonical ~15.5 kg/kW), conservative (~38 kg/kW Turyshev sensitivity), or current_2026 (~42 kg/kW F9-class).

name: evaluate_orbital_compute_regime
